narr: Deep monsoon moisture over central Arizona allowed for strong thunderstorms with heavy rain.
ev: The Verde River gauge 12 miles north-northwest of Jerome showed a 2.5 foot rise.
A family of 5 was hit by a flash flood in Labyrinth Canyon that drains into Lake Powell. The wife and mother drowned.
